sourceAccess.note: Description and identification 节给出工蜂胸长 2.3–6.9 mm、体重 68–754 mg;全文未提及盗蜜(nectar robbing)与头部器官构成。
Feeding 节描述口器(proboscis)及许多熊蜂种类咬穿花冠基部盗蜜;未逐一描述复眼/单眼/触角;未点名 B. terrestris 盗蜜。
给出盗蜜定义、熊蜂列为盗蜜者、短舌熊蜂(B. pratorum)够不到长花花蜜、对植物影响有时中性甚至正面。
无 URL,为离线文献(蜜蜂解剖学专著),无法在线核对;仅作为一般头部解剖(复眼、单眼、触角、口器)的背景来源。

claims.claim: 熊蜂头部由复眼、单眼、触角和口器构成
claims.judgment: 部分支持(口器)+ 未提及(复眼/单眼/触角)——属一般昆虫头部解剖常识,且已引 Snodgrass 解剖学专著,视为可接受
claims.evidence: Bumblebee: "The bumblebee tongue (the proboscis) is a long, hairy structure that extends from a sheath-like modified maxilla." / "When at rest or flying, the proboscis is kept folded under the head."

claims.claim: 遇到花冠很深、舌头够不到花蜜的花,熊蜂有时会在花冠基部咬孔取蜜
claims.judgment: 支持(属级),且已用"有时"限定
claims.evidence: Bumblebee: "Many species of bumblebees also exhibit 'nectar robbing': instead of inserting the mouthparts into the flower in the normal way, these bees bite directly through the base of the corolla to extract nectar, avoiding pollen transfer." / Nectar robbing: "Short-tongued bees such as the early bumblebee (Bombus pratorum) are unable to reach the nectar located at the base of long flowers such as comfreys."

claims.claim: 据记载也包括欧洲熊蜂(Bombus terrestris)
claims.judgment: 未提及,但已用"据记载"限定 → 已恰当限定
claims.evidence: Bombus terrestris 与 Bumblebee 两页均未点名 B. terrestris 盗蜜;Nectar robbing 页仅点名 B. pratorum。

claims.claim: 这种行为叫"盗蜜"(nectar robbing),只是行为名称,不带贬义
claims.evidence: Nectar robbing: "Nectar robbing is a foraging behavior used by some organisms that feed on floral nectar, carried out by feeding from holes bitten in flowers, rather than by entering through the flowers' natural openings." / "However, the effect of robbery on the plant is sometimes neutral or even positive."

claims.claim: 同一巢的工蜂胸部大小可差约 3 倍
claims.evidence: Bombus terrestris: "B. terrestris is unique compared to other bees in that their caste of workers exhibit a wide variation in worker size, with thorax sizes ranging from 2.3 to 6.9 mm in length and masses ranging from 68 to 754 mg."

claims.claim: 体重可差近十倍(不同资料 8–11 倍)
claims.judgment: 支持(754/68 ≈ 11.1,落在所述 8–11 倍区间,且已用"约/不同资料"限定)
claims.evidence: 同上:"masses ranging from 68 to 754 mg"。

issues.claim: 熊蜂头部同样由复眼、单眼、触角和口器构成
issues.problem: 提示(不影响裁决):可抓取的三个网页来源仅明确描述了口器(proboscis),复眼/单眼/触角依赖离线的 Snodgrass 蜜蜂解剖学专著,未能在线核对。
issues.evidence: Bumblebee 页仅有 "The bumblebee tongue (the proboscis) is a long, hairy structure...";Bombus terrestris 页未描述头部器官。
issues.fix: 无需改动正文;如需加强可在 sourceIds 中补充一条可在线访问的昆虫/蜜蜂头部解剖来源(如 Wikipedia "Insect morphology" 或 "Bee" 页)。

issues.claim: 据记载也包括欧洲熊蜂
issues.problem: 提示(不影响裁决):所引来源均未点名 Bombus terrestris 盗蜜,目前仅靠"据记载"限定托底。
